owned_question: At what granularity does this fact, metric, or record exist, and what cardinality constraints (uniqueness, fan-out of one-to-many aggregation, fan-in of many-source reconciliation) must hold for every number derived from it to keep referring to the same thing?

terms.gloss: exactly what one row/fact/metric observation represents, e.g. 'one line item on a retail sales receipt'; declared before dimensions and measures and treated as a binding contract
the finest level a business process captures data, versus pre-aggregated rolls; atomic grain withstands unpredictable queries, summaries assume questions in advance
the explicit mapping between an inspected subset and the target population/lot; a statistic is only meaningful relative to its sampling scheme (lot-by-lot inspection indexed by AQL)
declared bound on how many values may occur in a column or match a key: UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY multiplicity; SQL-standard-level machinery for asserting grain at rest
the particular quantity intended to be measured; redefining the measurand changes what the reported value refers to even at identical numeric magnitude
when an occurrence-grain fact aggregates upward to a coarser grain, the metric must declare which additive/semi-additive/non-additive rules preserve meaning (e.g. rates and balances do not sum)
when two sources are matched (dedup, entity resolution, ledger reconciliation), matching happens at a declared key grain; joining at mismatched grains multiplies rows or silently drops duplicates
terms.authority: standard relational join semantics + Kimball 'never mix grains in one table'

terms.gloss: aggregation collapses intragrain variation; drill-down cannot recover detail that was never retained, so coarser output never claims finer provenance

non_collapse_laws: an aggregate grain never inherits its components' uniqueness; a monthly total is not a row-for-row stand-in for the daily events it summed
a sampled statistic never crosses to population grain without a declared sample frame; no frame, no extrapolation
each distinct grain gets its own table/definition; mixing two grains in one fact set is a model error, not a convenience
an aggregated metric only flows through roll-up with a declared aggregation rule; non-additive measures (rates, balances, temperatures) refuse plain summation
drill-down returns only what was retained below the current grain; missing lower-grain detail is reported as lost, never imputed as if observed
a match/join/reconciliation keys onto a single declared grain; auto-merging records whose natural grains differ is forbidden until both sides are lifted to one declared grain
redefining the measurand (population, frame, time bucket, unit) produces a new quantity lineage, not a corrected old one
carrier_requirements: every published metric carries an explicit grain declaration: entity counted, occurrence type, time bucket, filter/population
stored tables carry machine-checkable cardinality constraints (key uniqueness, FK multiplicity) evaluated at write time
aggregation operators carry additivity class tags so fan-out through sums/averages/ratios is validated, not assumed
reconciliation outputs carry their match-key grain and a duplicate-collision report rather than silent multipliers or dedup
sampling-derived statistics carry their frame reference and design effect; drill-down surfaces expose which children were retained
invariants: one row = exactly one declared grain instance; duplicate detection against the declared grain is enforced
sum over children of a faithful roll-up equals the parent within declared uncertainty; a delta without an event lineage fails the audit
joining on a non-unique key at occurrence grain yields row multiplication flagged as error, not accepted as result
any statistic presented at population grain cites its frame; any statistic citing no frame is presentationally marked sampled-or-unknown
irreversibility ledger: every roll-up records what lower-grain information became unrecoverable
refusals: refuse to publish a rate or balance aggregated by summation across periods
refuse to merge two sources on inferred identity when their grains differ without an explicit lifting step
refuse population-level claims from a sample absent a declared sampling scheme and extrapolation basis
refuse drill-down promises into grains never stored
refuse a UNIQUE claim that write-time cardinality checking cannot reach (e.g. cross-system merges post-constraint)
counterexamples: daily conversion-rate series averaged into a monthly rate: averaging ratios misweights days; correct path recomputes numerator/denominator sums at month grain — intraday spikes were already lost at daily grain and are irrecoverable at monthly
two customer systems auto-merged on email at account grain while one stores device-occurrence grain: one account matches N device rows and revenue double-counts by fan-out factor N
AQL acceptance decision on a lot extrapolated to 'supplier defect rate' with no frame statement: lot-by-lot attribute schemes license accept/reject decisions, not population parameter estimates
'1,048 unique visitors' printed next to '3,204 sessions' without grain labels invites readers to treat counts at different grains as comparable metrics
authority_limit: This axis governs referential integrity of quantities across granularity changes — what a number is about and which cardinality obligations survive transformation. It does not own measurement accuracy (uncertainty budgets), semantic correctness of definitions beyond their stated scope, or access/security policy on data.
